description: This file defines API routes for the flood risk forecasting feature of the system. It uses FastAPI to set up an endpoint that generates or retrieves multi-year flood risk predictions, primarily querying a database and possibly invoking ML models for predictions. It includes detailed API documentation through docstrings and FastAPI annotations, and interacts with external modules for database access, ML prediction, and data schemas.

classes.name: ForecastRequest
classes.description: Schema for the forecast request payload, including parameters like years and options.

classes.name: ForecastResponse
classes.description: Schema for the forecast response, including prediction data, metadata, and success status.

classes.name: CitywideRiskRecord
classes.description: Schema for individual forecast records for each year, including risk scores, categories, and climate factors.

methods.name: ForecastResponse generate_forecast(request: ForecastRequest)
methods.description: API endpoint handler that retrieves or generates flood risk forecasts based on request parameters, querying the database, and optionally invoking ML models.
